topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Life's got a way of looping back on itself, doesn't it? I was sitting there, sipping what ought to have been my last cup of cold coffee, when she drops this on me. "You know, Dad," she says, flipping through a book with the same distracted look her old man used to get when he was working a case, "I think I might have the same teacher you did when you were in high school." The gears in my head started turning, trying to match that to a face, a voice, a time. That hand-me-down wisdom, passed down another generation. The city might change, but some things just stick around, like an old case file you can never quite close.
